title: Profile bridge receipt (pairwise, directional, paid) — CANDIDATE, non-binding
description: The paid crossing: converts an artifact valid under one profile into a NAMED use under another, by discharging the declared bridge obligations. Pairwise and directional — no bridge mediates every pair (no master profile). A gate may VERIFY a presented bridge receipt; it must never synthesize one (bridges enter only by assumption).

bridge_id.description: Identifier of the DECLARED bridge this receipt pays. A receipt citing an undeclared bridge is not a bridge receipt.

from_profile.description: The home-project profile the artifact is valid under.

to_use.description: The SPECIFIC consumer-side use this crossing licenses (e.g. consumer 'agent_governor', use 'admission_evidence'). One use — not a blanket grant; receipts are scoped to obligations and are not fungible.

discharged_by.description: Evidence reference (receipt id / content hash) for the discharge. A signature alone does not discharge a bridge obligation (WLP doctrine line).

obligations_discharged.description: Each obligation from the from_profile's bridge_obligations_required, with its discharge evidence. The gate checks set-completeness against the profile; completeness is gate-enforced, not schema-expressible.

custodian.description: Who custodies the claim that this bridge exists and was paid. A bridge is a claim someone must custody.

content_digest.description: Content digest of this receipt's canonical body.
